question: Do observed values on different pages and states support the same semantic role and proposed token scope?
procedure: Compare the same intended role across every relevant frozen core page, not merely matching hex values or CSS names.

Keep at least one inspectable painted-control proof per core page (URL, selector, visible region, state, background and foreground); distinguish this from the number of controls counted only in an aggregate.
Record an observed Claim or an explicit unavailable reason for each relevant page and state.
Describe agreement and conflicts; a local search action does not establish a global primary CTA.
Choose the narrowest supported scope: global, scenario, component, state-only or unmapped.
A global token with an unexplained conflict or an unreviewed core page must not be handed to Demo or host design.
notFor: Treating a single page as cross-page agreement
readerPurpose: 执行判断的步骤与取舍
